info.name: CodeScan Organization Analytics
info.description:
Every API behind the organization Analytics page.

- **SonarQube (api/analytics)**: analyses, issues, quality gates and security remediation.
- **CodeScan services (/_codescan/analytics)**: AI debt health, AI add-ons, IDE plugins, pull requests.

All requests are GET and read-only. Authentication: a user token as the Basic auth username with an empty password (set the `token` variable). The user must administer the organization.

Set the variables `baseUrl`, `token`, `organization`, `from`, `to` and `timeZone` before sending.

variable.description: Server URL, without a trailing slash.
User token of an organization administrator.
Time zone of the days, e.g. Europe/Paris.

Debt health score of the organization (from AI debt analysis): average score, weekly trend, biggest movers, lowest projects, quality gate changes of the last 7 days, top root causes.

**Status:** Part of the original Analytics feature.

Requires the *admin* role on the organization.

**Status:** Part of the original Analytics feature. Changed: fixJobs adds effortSavedMinutes (remediation effort of the issues AI resolved) and issuesWithoutKnownEffort.

Requires the *admin* role on the organization.
